description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Sets the signed-in user's alert for new jobs in a role, optionally filtered by seniority and city; techjobs.vn sends matching new jobs as a digest. One alert per role: calling it for a role that already has one replaces its filters, and the same call twice changes nothing.

cadence.description: How often to send the digest; omit to keep the current one (weekly for a new alert).

cities.description: Only jobs in these places (remote = remote jobs); omit for anywhere.

role.description: The role to get new jobs for. Map the user's words to one of these, e.g. "React" → Frontend, "Golang" → Backend, "SRE" → DevOps / SRE.

seniority.description: Only jobs at this seniority; omit for any.

name: set_role_alert
title: Set a role alert
